subject.title: fix(imessage): prevent duplicate messages after delayed sends

question: Should the documented production incident, direct imsg timing contract, deterministic 158-second regression, and accepted delivery-versus-latency tradeoff be recorded as a formal proof override for this PR?
rationale: The contributor's real run shows a fast-path delivery but cannot safely force the delayed AppleScript fallback without risking a real duplicate; only a maintainer can accept that proof substitution for merge.

options.title: Request delayed-boundary diagnostics
options.body: Require redacted runtime diagnostics from a delayed fallback before merge so the exact changed path has real after-fix evidence.

options.title: Record a proof override
options.body: Accept the documented dependency contract and deterministic coverage as the safe substitute for fault injection, then clear the proof gate explicitly.
